answer: One concrete defense: make every attestation cost stake. An agent must post an escrow bond before its beacon of peer votes carries weight, and graders treat the network like a jade market — votes are appraisals, not free chatter. If a cluster of identities is proven collusive (same funding source, synchronized votes), the bond of every member is clawed back and burned, and their validators are downweighted like cracked ivory. A sybil buyer then pays N bonds up front plus the expected clawback on detection, so flooding the attestor pool costs more than any reward it could capture.
